images.title: Grow a Garden: Seed shop window (early version)
images.license: Fandom wiki page text is CC BY-SA; the picture is a game screenshot (Roblox game, all rights reserved), look only
images.copy: One window over the world: green title bar with a calm restock line, one big red X to close, big cards with a picture, name, stock and one price. Frame taken from the wiki gallery image SeedshopUI.png at 800 px.

images.title: Grow a Garden: Sam's stall, sign and top buttons
images.license: YouTube short by ZionCalebTV (all rights reserved); paused frame, looked at only, look only
images.copy: The stall is easy to find: a wooden SEED SHOP sign, a striped roof, the shop keeper stands behind the counter, a name bar above him. Big word buttons at the top of the screen (SEEDS, GARDEN, SELL) jump you to the stalls. No prompt visible in this frame.

images.title: Grow a Garden: shop window open, world still visible
images.license: YouTube video by NoobBlox (all rights reserved); paused frame at about 0:42, look only
images.copy: The shop window sits on one side so the stall and the player stay visible. Top row of word buttons, one Shop button on the left edge. Rarity shown as a coloured word on each card.

images.title: Grow a Garden: player at Sam's stall just before the window opens
images.license: YouTube video by NoobBlox (all rights reserved); paused frame at about 0:26, look only
images.copy: A small icon sits beside the keeper's name bar (the tap/press spot); the player stands right at the SEED SHOP sign. The window opened a second or two later. Exact trigger not proven by this frame.
